news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Receives FDA Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy (RMAT) Designation for LX2020 for the Treatment of PKP2 Arrhythmogenic Cardiomyopathy
news.summary: The FDA granted RMAT designation to LX2020, Lexeo's AAV-based gene therapy for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy, based on interim HEROIC-PKP2 Phase I/II data showing a favorable safety profile and reduced arrhythmia burden. The designation gives Lexeo more frequent FDA interaction and potential eligibility for accelerated approval and priority review.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Announces Publication in JAMA Cardiology of Phase I/II Data for LX2006 in Friedreich Ataxia
news.summary: Peer-reviewed Phase I/II results for LX2006 in Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy were published in JAMA Cardiology, reporting reductions in left ventricular mass index and increases in frataxin protein expression across dose cohorts. The publication lends independent scientific validation to data the company has used to support its accelerated-approval strategy.

news.headline: Lexeo Therapeutics Announces Regulatory Update and Registrational Trial Design for LX2006 Gene Therapy in Friedreich Ataxia
news.summary: Lexeo finalized the protocol and statistical analysis plan for its SUNRISE-FA2 pivotal trial of LX2006, with the FDA confirming no additional nonclinical bridging studies are required and commercial-scale drug product ready for dosing. The open-label study will randomize 13 treated versus 13 untreated participants with a 6-month LVMI primary endpoint, targeting a 2028 BLA filing under the accelerated approval pathway.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Lexeo has historically reported Q2 results in mid-August (Aug 14, 2025 for Q2 2025); the Q2 2026 report and operational update has not yet been released as of Aug 10, 2026.

catalysts.label: SUNRISE-FA2 topline data (LX2006, Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy)
catalysts.detail: Topline 6-month LVMI data from the pivotal SUNRISE-FA2 trial, initiated mid-2026, is guided by the company for the second half of 2027.

catalysts.label: LX2006 BLA submission
catalysts.detail: Company guidance is to submit a Biologics License Application to the FDA for LX2006 in Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy in 2028, seeking accelerated approval.

catalysts.label: Further LX2020 regulatory/clinical updates post-RMAT
catalysts.detail: Following the August 2026 RMAT designation, Lexeo is expected to continue FDA discussions on a registrational pathway for LX2020 in PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy and to provide further HEROIC-PKP2 data updates.

pulse: Lexeo is a clinical-stage cardiac gene therapy company advancing two lead AAV programs toward registration: LX2006 for Friedreich ataxia cardiomyopathy just locked in its pivotal SUNRISE-FA2 trial design (targeting a 2028 BLA), while LX2020 for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy just received FDA RMAT designation off positive interim data. With roughly $246.6 million in cash as of year-end 2025 (guided to fund operations into 2028), the near-term story is regulatory and enrollment progress rather than imminent efficacy readouts, with the next major data points not expected until second-half 2027.
